Maya Patel: Heads-up — PR #4123 merged but the Go SDK snippet in optimize/kv-prefetch.md is out of date and CI is failing on examples. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
Devon Liu: On it. I saw the sample uses old client.New() signatures. I'll push a quick patch to replace with SDK v2 constructor and update the quant-profile reference.
Sara Ortiz: Do we have tests that validate the snippet output? If not, can we at least run samplegen locally before merging?
Devon Liu: samplegen failed in CI: see bot message below. I can run locally but might need a small tweak to the shell wrapper.
Tomás Rivera: CI error looks like: `samples/test_examples.go:42: undefined: OldClient` — simple find/replace. Also the caching TTL example in optimize/cache.md still uses milliseconds instead of duration literal, we should standardize.
doc-bot: [automated] samplegen/examples-ci reported 3 failures in docs/examples for branch: pr/4123 — failing files: optimize/kv-prefetch.md (go snippet), optimize/cache.md (ttl example). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/4567/logs
Maya Patel: Okay, owners: @Devon Liu for the Go snippet fix, @Tomás Rivera can you take cache TTL normalisation? Sara, can you smoke-test the examples after fixes and re-run samplegen?
Devon Liu: Working on a small patch: will replace `OldClient` -> `newsdk.Client` and update auth example to use `WithAPIKey()` pattern. Patch branch pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/compare/fix/go-snippet-4123
Devon Liu: Quick snippet to replace (will include in PR):
```go
client := newsdk.NewClient(ctx, newsdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, &newsdk.GenerateRequest{Model: "redwood/opt-1", Prompt: "Hello"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(string(resp.Text))
```
Sara Ortiz: That looks good to me. I'll run samplegen locally once the branch is ready. Can you also add a one-line migration note in optimize/upgrade.md so users know the constructor changed?
Devon Liu: Added migration note and updated the link to quant profiles table. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4127
Tomás Rivera: I opened a tiny PR for TTL normalisation (ms -> time.Duration): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4128 — includes a unit example `cache.WithTTL(30 * time.Second)`.
Sara Ortiz: Re-ran samplegen on dev branch after Devon's patch — all examples pass locally, samplegen v0.4.1. Kicked CI rerun.
doc-bot: [automated] CI re-run started for PR #4127 and PR #4128.
Devon Liu: CI green and merged PR #4127 (merge commit 1704200567).
Tomás Rivera: PR #4128 merged as well.
Maya Patel: Awesome — thanks all. I'll add a short note in the release changelog and pin a follow-up task to audit other optimize snippets for SDK v2 compatibility.
Sara Ortiz: I'll file the audit ticket and assign to docs-rotation.
Maya Patel: :thumbsup: closing this thread once ticket is up.
